interface.shortDescription: Contemplative reasoning — Lotus Sutra wisdom framework with journey visualization
interface.longDescription: Lotus Wisdom is a contemplative reasoning MCP server rooted in the Lotus Sutra wisdom framework. It guides structured problem-solving through process flow, skillful means, non-dual recognition, meta-cognition, and meditation, with an interactive journey visualization via MCP ext-apps. Runs locally over stdio using the committed server bundle and journey HTML, with no npm install required.
